svg.aria-label: BBox-SigLIP is a dual encoder. The JSON query, box and description together, goes through the text encoder into one embedding; each gallery image goes through the image encoder into one embedding; the score is their dot product. Only the image with the dog inside the box scores high. A small sketch in the corner shows the two encoders as the two halves of one model.
